metadata.question: Did tropospheric nitrogen dioxide (NO2) concentrations over New York City appear higher at 2:00-3:00 pm than at 5:00-6:00 pm local time on August 9, 2023?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-5P TROPOMI NO2 L3 collections over a NYC bounding box on 2023-08-09. Compare two local-time windows converted to UTC: 14:00–15:00 LT => 18:00–19:00 UTC; 17:00–18:00 LT => 21:00–22:00 UTC. Try OFFL first, then NRTI if empty.
2. Masking strategy: Mask pixels with qa_value < 0.75. Build per-window composites using qualityMosaic('qa_value'). Report pixel counts (non-masked) and mean cloud fraction for validation.
3. Logic: If any window has empty collection -> C1. If any window has 0 valid pixels after masking -> C2. If mean is null/NaN/invalid -> C3. Otherwise compare means: higher at 14–15 LT than 17–18 LT => A, else B.
</thinking>

const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const nyc = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-74.3, 40.4, -73.6, 41.0], null, false);
    const dateStr = '2023-08-09';
    // Local to UTC: EDT = UTC-4
    const w1_start = '2023-08-09T18:00:00'; // 14:00-15:00 LT
    const w1_end   = '2023-08-09T19:00:00';
    const w2_start = '2023-08-09T21:00:00'; // 17:00-18:00 LT
    const w2_end   = '2023-08-09T22:00:00';

    // Datasets
    const OFFL = 'COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2';
    const NRTI = 'COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI/L3_NO2';
    const band = 'tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density';

    function getWindowCollection(dataset, start, end) {
      return ee.ImageCollection(dataset)
        .filterBounds(nyc)
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .select([band, 'qa_value', 'cloud_fraction']);
    }

    function prepareComposite(col) {
      // QA mask and quality mosaic by qa_value to maximize valid coverage
      const masked = col.map(img => img.updateMask(img.select('qa_value').gte(0.75)));
      const mosaic = masked.qualityMosaic('qa_value');
      return mosaic;
    }

    async function statsForWindow(start, end) {
      // Try OFFL first
      let col = getWindowCollection(OFFL, start, end);
      let size = await col.size().getInfo();
      let datasetUsed = 'OFFL';
      if (size === 0) {
        // Fallback to NRTI
        col = getWindowCollection(NRTI, start, end);
        size = await col.size().getInfo();
        datasetUsed = 'NRTI';
      }
      return { col, size, datasetUsed };
    }

    async function computeStats(col) {
      const img = prepareComposite(col);
      // Pixel count of valid tropospheric NO2 after masking
      const pxCount = await img.select(band).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: nyc,
        scale: 3000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get(band).getInfo();
      if (!pxCount || pxCount === 0) {
        return { pxCount: 0, meanNO2: null, cloudMean: null };
      }
      const meanNO2 = await img.select(band).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: nyc,
        scale: 3000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get(band).getInfo();
      const cloudMean = await img.select('cloud_fraction').reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: nyc,
        scale: 3000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('cloud_fraction').getInfo();
      return { pxCount, meanNO2, cloudMean };
    }

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check (with fallbacks)
    const w1 = await statsForWindow(w1_start, w1_end);
    const w2 = await statsForWindow(w2_start, w2_end);

    if (w1.size === 0 || w2.size === 0) {
      console.log(`Window1 ${w1_start}-${w1_end} ${w1.datasetUsed} Images: ${w1.size}`);
      console.log(`Window2 ${w2_start}-${w2_end} ${w2.datasetUsed} Images: ${w2.size}`);
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Processing and pixel-count validation
    const w1Stats = await computeStats(w1.col);
    const w2Stats = await computeStats(w2.col);

    console.log(`Window1 ${w1_start}-${w1_end} ${w1.datasetUsed} Images: ${w1.size}`);
    console.log(`W1 Valid px: ${w1Stats.pxCount}, Mean NO2: ${w1Stats.meanNO2 !== null ? w1Stats.meanNO2.toExponential(3) : 'null'} mol/m^2, Cloud: ${w1Stats.cloudMean !== null ? w1Stats.cloudMean.toFixed(2) : 'null'}`);

    console.log(`Window2 ${w2_start}-${w2_end} ${w2.datasetUsed} Images: ${w2.size}`);
    console.log(`W2 Valid px: ${w2Stats.pxCount}, Mean NO2: ${w2Stats.meanNO2 !== null ? w2Stats.meanNO2.toExponential(3) : 'null'} mol/m^2, Cloud: ${w2Stats.cloudMean !== null ? w2Stats.cloudMean.toFixed(2) : 'null'}`);

    if (w1Stats.pxCount === 0 || w2Stats.pxCount === 0) {
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Calculation validation
    const m1 = w1Stats.meanNO2;
    const m2 = w2Stats.meanNO2;
    if (m1 === null || m2 === null || !isFinite(m1) || !isFinite(m2)) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // 5. Final Answer: Is 14-15 LT higher than 17-18 LT?
    // Note: Negative values can occur; still compare numerically.
    const answer = (m1 > m2) ? 'A' : 'B';
    console.log(answer);
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err && err.message ? err.message : err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
